verdict.rationale: Otter documents several built-in background automations a user can enable: scheduling the notetaker to auto-join all Zoom/Teams/Meet meetings, auto-syncing next steps to CRMs, auto-sending transcripts to Airtable, S3 and Drive, pushing action items to Jira and Asana, pre-meeting briefing delivery, and triggering actions from meeting content via the API and webhooks. These are fixed, meeting-centric pipelines, and custom automation depends on Zapier or building against the API rather than a native rule or agent builder. Community reports of the bot auto-joining and emailing summaries confirm it runs unattended. Missing for 10: a native user-defined automation/agent builder with custom triggers and conditions, documentation of how to configure automations, and independent hands-on evidence of configurable background workflows beyond auto-join.
